notes: A simpler Focus card on Today: one suggestion with a blue Start and Just one paper, the session’s goal in one line, and this week in one line. Change picks another set or a to-do; More has the lengths, Just 3 papers, the goal, Finish by and shortest first.

How long a set will take now comes only from that set’s own papers: no time before the first one, a rough guess after one or two, and all the time spent on it counts. Time with nothing done for a few minutes no longer counts in a focus session on papers.
Away from the marking screen, Ctrl Z now takes back a long run of changes a few seconds at a time, and the note it shows has a Redo button.
